name: Yomi
source:
[url=/c48636]Idzuna[/url]'s younger sister.

[spoiler]Was originally meant to be a sacrificial offering to the gods as a baby, before her parents stepped in to prevent it. Thusly, her parents were sacrificed instead.

Thanks to [url=/c48638]Ruruka[/url]'s betrayal, was later on forced to watch her brother get sacrificed right in front of her eyes, and then later shredded to pieces by a pack of wolves. And on top of that, she was also stabbed by the villagers.[/spoiler]
